hsk.note: Local HSK 2.0 Level 1 vocabulary includes 三 (sān).

importance: 三 helps learners read and write three. Start with 三个 (three items) and compare the other everyday uses below.

components.explanation: Three separate horizontal strokes create three levels. The middle line is shorter than the other two, and the bottom line forms the broadest level.

readingNotes: Read 三 as sān in this guide. Compare 三个 (sān ge) and 三月 (sānyuè) to practise the sound in complete words.
usageTitle: Using 三 in words and sentences
usage: 三 counts things and appears in dates. 三月 means March, while 三个月 is a duration of three months.
writingTip: Write the horizontals from top to bottom; make the middle line shortest and the bottom line longest.

exampleSentences.meaning: I have three books.
We will meet at three.

exampleSentences.pinyin: Tā zài zhèlǐ zhù le sān ge yuè.
exampleSentences.meaning: She lived here for three months.

confusableCharacter.guidance: 三 has three horizontal lines, while 二 has only two.

seo.title: 三 (sān) Stroke Order, Meaning & Examples
seo.h1: How to Write 三 (sān): Stroke Order, Meaning & Examples
seo.description: Write 三 (sān) in three strokes. Compare its line lengths with 二, learn 三月 versus 三个月, and practise counting and dates.

hsk.note: Local HSK 2.0 Level 1 vocabulary includes 四 (sì).

importance: 四 helps learners read and write four. Start with 四个 (four items) and compare the other everyday uses below.

components.explanation: A large outer enclosure contains two short strokes. The interior is not a cross, and the enclosure is wider than the tall form of 目.

readingNotes: Read 四 as sì in this guide. Compare 四个 (sì ge) and 四月 (sìyuè) to practise the sound in complete words.
usageTitle: Using 四 in words and sentences
usage: 四 counts four things. 星期四 means Thursday and 四月 is April; 四个月 instead expresses a four-month duration.
writingTip: Leave space for the two inner strokes, and close the outer box at the bottom after writing the inside.

exampleSentences.meaning: There are four people here.
Today is Thursday.
We are travelling to China in April.

confusableCharacter.guidance: 四 has two separate inner strokes; 西 has a different interior and an extra top horizontal.

seo.title: 四 (sì) Stroke Order, Meaning & Examples
seo.h1: How to Write 四 (sì): Stroke Order, Meaning & Examples
seo.description: Learn 四 (sì), the five-stroke number four. See how its enclosure differs from 西 and use it in 星期四, 四月, and counting phrases.

hsk.note: Local HSK 2.0 Level 1 vocabulary includes 五 (wǔ).

importance: 五 helps learners read and write five. Start with 五个 (five items) and compare the other everyday uses below.

components.explanation: The short top horizontal, central crossing and turning stroke, and longer bottom horizontal form a compact connected shape.

readingNotes: Read 五 as wǔ in this guide. Compare 五个 (wǔ ge) and 五月 (wǔyuè) to practise the sound in complete words.
usageTitle: Using 五 in words and sentences
usage: 五 appears in numbers, dates and times. 五点 is five o'clock and 五分钟 is a duration of five minutes.
writingTip: Keep the central turn within the width of the bottom horizontal, then finish with a broad and level base.

exampleSentences.meaning: I have five pens.
It is five o'clock now.
Please wait another five minutes.

confusableCharacter.guidance: 五 and 互 have different middle turns; compare the central strokes rather than only the top and base.

seo.title: 五 (wǔ) Stroke Order, Meaning & Examples
seo.h1: How to Write 五 (wǔ): Stroke Order, Meaning & Examples
seo.description: Practise 五 (wǔ) stroke order and its central turn. Learn the difference between 五点 and 五分钟 with number words and example sentences.

hsk.note: Local HSK 2.0 Level 1 vocabulary includes 六 (liù).

importance: 六 helps learners read and write six. Start with 六个 (six items) and compare the other everyday uses below.

components.explanation: A dot above a horizontal forms 亠. Two separate lower strokes spread out beneath this cover without crossing each other.

readingNotes: Read 六 as liù in this guide. Compare 六个 (liù ge) and 六月 (liùyuè) to practise the sound in complete words.
usageTitle: Using 六 in words and sentences
usage: 六 counts objects and names dates. 星期六 is Saturday and 六月 is June; the following word tells what is counted.
writingTip: Centre the top dot above the horizontal and leave a gap before the two lower strokes spread apart.

exampleSentences.meaning: Six people came.
I do not have class on Saturday.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 我们六月开始学习汉语。
exampleSentences.meaning: We start learning Chinese in June.

confusableCharacter.guidance: 六 stops after its lower spreading strokes; 交 has additional crossing strokes below.

seo.title: 六 (liù) Stroke Order, Meaning & Examples
seo.h1: How to Write 六 (liù): Stroke Order, Meaning & Examples
seo.description: Write 六 (liù) with a centred top dot and separated lower strokes. Practise 六月, 星期六, and everyday counting in four strokes.

hsk.note: Local HSK 2.0 Level 1 vocabulary includes 七 (qī).

importance: 七 helps learners read and write seven. Start with 七个 (seven items) and compare the other everyday uses below.

components.explanation: One horizontal crosses a second stroke that bends at the bottom and ends with a hook. That bend distinguishes the outline from a straight cross.

readingNotes: Read 七 as qī in this guide. Compare 七个 (qī ge) and 七月 (qīyuè) to practise the sound in complete words.
usageTitle: Using 七 in words and sentences
usage: 七点 gives a time, 七天 gives a duration, and 七月 names July. Use a measure word when counting most objects.
writingTip: Place the crossing above the middle and keep a visible bend and hook at the bottom of the second stroke.

exampleSentences.meaning: It is seven o'clock.
I am going to Beijing in July.

exampleSentences.pinyin: Zhè běn shū wǒ kàn le qī tiān.
exampleSentences.meaning: I read this book over seven days.

confusableCharacter.guidance: 七 has a bent hooked stroke, while 十 is a straight cross.

seo.title: 七 (qī) Stroke Order, Meaning & Examples
seo.h1: How to Write 七 (qī): Stroke Order, Meaning & Examples
seo.description: See the two strokes of 七 (qī), including its lower bend and hook. Compare 七 with 十 and practise times, dates, and seven-day durations.

hsk.note: Local HSK 2.0 Level 1 vocabulary includes 八 (bā).

importance: 八 helps learners read and write eight. Start with 八个 (eight items) and compare the other everyday uses below.

components.explanation: Two falling strokes diverge toward the lower corners. Their upper ends remain separated rather than meeting as they do in 人.

readingNotes: Read 八 as bā in this guide. Compare 八个 (bā ge) and 八月 (bāyuè) to practise the sound in complete words.
usageTitle: Using 八 in words and sentences
usage: 八 builds larger numbers as well as counting eight things. 八十 means eighty, while 十八 means eighteen.
writingTip: Write the left fall before the right fall, keeping the two upper ends apart and the lower ends spread wide.

exampleSentences.meaning: There are eight books here.
He is eighteen this year.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 我们每天八点开始工作。
exampleSentences.pinyin: Wǒmen měitiān bā diǎn kāishǐ gōngzuò.
exampleSentences.meaning: We start work at eight every day.

confusableCharacter.guidance: 八 has separated upper ends, whereas the strokes of 人 meet near the top.

seo.title: 八 (bā) Stroke Order, Meaning & Examples
seo.h1: How to Write 八 (bā): Stroke Order, Meaning & Examples
seo.description: Learn 八 (bā) in two strokes, keeping its upper ends apart. Compare 八 with 人 and distinguish 八十 from 十八 in number practice.

hsk.note: Local HSK 2.0 Level 1 vocabulary includes 九 (jiǔ).

importance: 九 helps learners read and write nine. Start with 九个 (nine items) and compare the other everyday uses below.

components.explanation: A left-falling stroke crosses a turning stroke with a hooked finish. There is no separate dot within the outline.

readingNotes: Read 九 as jiǔ in this guide. Compare 九个 (jiǔ ge) and 九月 (jiǔyuè) to practise the sound in complete words.
usageTitle: Using 九 in words and sentences
usage: 九 is useful for dates and ages. 九月 is September and 九十九 is ninety-nine; 岁 follows an age in years.
writingTip: Write the left fall first; keep the turning stroke open and preserve the small finishing hook on its right.

exampleSentences.meaning: She is nine years old.
Our school term starts in September.

exampleSentences.pinyin: Qǐng zài jiǔ diǎn yǐqián dào xuéxiào.
exampleSentences.meaning: Please arrive at school before nine.

confusableCharacter.guidance: 九 has no separate dot; adding one produces 丸, a different character.

seo.title: 九 (jiǔ) Stroke Order, Meaning & Examples
seo.h1: How to Write 九 (jiǔ): Stroke Order, Meaning & Examples
seo.description: Write 九 (jiǔ), preserve its final hook, and compare it with 丸. Practise 九月, ages, and numbers such as 十九 and 九十.

hsk.note: Local HSK 2.0 Level 1 vocabulary includes 十 (shí).

importance: 十 helps learners read and write ten. Start with 十个 (ten items) and compare the other everyday uses below.

components.explanation: A horizontal and a vertical intersect to form a cross. The vertical extends above and below the horizontal; there is no bottom base line.

readingNotes: Read 十 as shí in this guide. Compare 十个 (shí ge) and 十月 (shíyuè) to practise the sound in complete words.
usageTitle: Using 十 in words and sentences
usage: 十 builds teens and multiples of ten. 十五 is fifteen, 五十 is fifty, and 十月 is October; character order matters.
writingTip: Write the horizontal before the vertical and keep their crossing near the centre, with the vertical extending below.

exampleSentences.meaning: I have ten yuan.
It is half past ten.

exampleSentences.pinyin: Tā zài zhèlǐ gōngzuò le shí nián.
exampleSentences.meaning: He worked here for ten years.

confusableCharacter.guidance: 十 has no bottom horizontal; adding that line changes it into 土.

seo.title: 十 (shí) Stroke Order, Meaning & Examples
seo.h1: How to Write 十 (shí): Stroke Order, Meaning & Examples
seo.description: Learn 十 (shí) stroke order and how it differs from 土. Use the ten character to build 十五, 五十, dates, and time expressions.

hsk.note: Local HSK 2.0 Level 2 vocabulary includes 百 (bǎi).

importance: 百 helps learners read and write hundred. Start with 一百 (one hundred) and compare the other everyday uses below.

components.explanation: A horizontal cap sits above a compact lower form resembling 白. The short stroke beneath the cap and the line inside the box remain distinct.

readingNotes: Read 百 as bǎi in this guide. Compare 一百 (yì bǎi) and 三百 (sān bǎi) to practise the sound in complete words.
usageTitle: Using 百 in words and sentences
usage: 百 usually follows another number: 一百 is one hundred and 三百 is three hundred. 百分之 introduces a percentage.
writingTip: Leave a small gap beneath the top horizontal, and keep the short inner line inside the lower box clearly visible.

exampleSentences.pinyin: Zhè běn shū yì bǎi yè.
exampleSentences.meaning: This book has one hundred pages.

exampleSentences.pinyin: Zhè jiàn yīfu sān bǎi yuán.
exampleSentences.meaning: This item of clothing costs three hundred yuan.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 这所学校有一百年的历史。
exampleSentences.pinyin: Zhè suǒ xuéxiào yǒu yì bǎi nián de lìshǐ.
exampleSentences.meaning: This school has a hundred years of history.

confusableCharacter.guidance: 百 has a horizontal cap above its lower form; 白 starts with a short slant.

seo.title: 百 (bǎi) Stroke Order, Meaning & Examples
seo.h1: How to Write 百 (bǎi): Stroke Order, Meaning & Examples
seo.description: Write 百 (bǎi) in six strokes and compare 百 with 白. Learn hundreds, prices, and the expression 百分之 through words and sentences.

hsk.note: Local HSK 2.0 Level 2 vocabulary includes 千 (qiān).

importance: 千 helps learners read and write thousand. Start with 一千 (one thousand) and compare the other everyday uses below.

components.explanation: A short slant sits above a horizontal crossed by a vertical. The slanted first stroke distinguishes this character from 干.

readingNotes: Read 千 as qiān in this guide. Compare 一千 (yì qiān) and 三千 (sān qiān) to practise the sound in complete words.
usageTitle: Using 千 in words and sentences
usage: 千 counts thousands. 一千 means one thousand, while 千米 is the unit kilometre; the compound can name a unit.
writingTip: Keep the initial short slant distinct from the horizontal below, then draw the vertical through the crossbar.

exampleSentences.pinyin: Zhè tiáo lù cháng yì qiānmǐ.
exampleSentences.meaning: This road is one kilometre long.

exampleSentences.pinyin: Xuéxiào yǒu sān qiān ge xuésheng.
exampleSentences.meaning: The school has three thousand students.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 这里离北京有一千多千米。
exampleSentences.pinyin: Zhèlǐ lí Běijīng yǒu yì qiān duō qiānmǐ.
exampleSentences.meaning: It is over a thousand kilometres from here to Beijing.

confusableCharacter.guidance: 千 starts with a short slant, whereas 干 starts with a horizontal.

seo.title: 千 (qiān) Stroke Order, Meaning & Examples
seo.h1: How to Write 千 (qiān): Stroke Order, Meaning & Examples
seo.description: Learn 千 (qiān), its slanted first stroke, and its contrast with 干. Practise thousands and the measurement word 千米 with examples.

hsk.note: Local HSK 2.0 Level 3 vocabulary includes 口 (kǒu).

importance: 口 helps learners read and write mouth; opening. Start with 门口 (doorway) and compare the other everyday uses below.

components.explanation: Three connected strokes enclose an empty square. The top and right edge are one turning stroke rather than two separate lines.

readingNotes: Read 口 as kǒu in this guide. Compare 门口 (ménkǒu) and 人口 (rénkǒu) to practise the sound in complete words.
usageTitle: Using 口 in words and sentences
usage: 口 can mean mouth or opening and can count family members. 门口 is a doorway; 三口人 describes a family of three.
writingTip: Write the left side, the top-right turn, and then the bottom; keep the enclosure small and upright rather than round.

exampleSentences.meaning: Please wait for me at the doorway.

exampleSentences.pinyin: Wǒ jiā yǒu sān kǒu rén.
exampleSentences.meaning: There are three people in my family.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 我想提高自己的汉语口语。
exampleSentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng tígāo zìjǐ de Hànyǔ kǒuyǔ.
exampleSentences.meaning: I want to improve my spoken Chinese.

confusableCharacter.guidance: 口 has an empty interior, while 日 contains an extra horizontal.

seo.title: 口 (kǒu) Stroke Order, Meaning & Examples
seo.h1: How to Write 口 (kǒu): Stroke Order, Meaning & Examples
seo.description: Write 口 (kǒu) in three strokes. Learn its mouth and opening senses, family counting with 三口人, and words such as 门口 and 口语.

hsk.note: Local HSK 3.0 Level 1 vocabulary includes 手 (shǒu).

importance: 手 helps learners read and write hand. Start with 手机 (mobile phone) and compare the other everyday uses below.

components.explanation: A short slant and two horizontals are crossed by a central stroke ending in a hook. The hook points differently from the lower turn of 毛.

readingNotes: Read 手 as shǒu in this guide. Compare 手机 (shǒujī) and 洗手 (xǐshǒu) to practise the sound in complete words.
usageTitle: Using 手 in words and sentences
usage: 手 names a hand and appears in actions and devices. 手机 is a mobile phone, while 洗手 means wash one's hands.
writingTip: Keep the upper slant short, space the horizontals evenly, and centre the final hooked stroke through the middle.

exampleSentences.meaning: Please wash your hands first.

exampleSentences.pinyin: Wǒ de shǒujī zài zhuōzi shàng.
exampleSentences.meaning: My phone is on the table.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 吃饭以前，我们都要洗手。
exampleSentences.pinyin: Chī fàn yǐqián, wǒmen dōu yào xǐshǒu.
exampleSentences.meaning: Before eating, we all need to wash our hands.

confusableCharacter.guidance: 手 finishes with a central vertical hook, whereas 毛 has a hook turning toward the right.

seo.title: 手 (shǒu) Stroke Order, Meaning & Examples
seo.h1: How to Write 手 (shǒu): Stroke Order, Meaning & Examples
seo.description: Learn 手 (shǒu) stroke order, its central hook, and the difference from 毛. Practise 手机, 洗手, 左手, and 右手 in useful sentences.

hsk.note: Local HSK 3.0 Level 6 vocabulary includes 足 (jù). This is word-family evidence, not a standalone level assignment for this character.

importance: 足 helps learners read and write foot; sufficient. Start with 足球 (football) and compare the other everyday uses below.

components.explanation: A small 口 sits above a spreading lower form. The right-falling finish belongs to the lower part, not to the upper box.

readingNotes: Read 足 as zú in this guide. Compare 足球 (zúqiú) and 足够 (zúgòu) to practise the sound in complete words.
usageTitle: Using 足 in words and sentences
usage: 足 means foot in 足球 and sufficient in 足够. The compound distinguishes the body-part sense from the meaning enough.
writingTip: Keep the upper box small and leave room for the lower strokes; finish with a broad right fall supporting the character.

exampleSentences.meaning: I like football.
This money is enough.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 放学以后，他们一起去踢足球。
exampleSentences.pinyin: Fàngxué yǐhòu, tāmen yìqǐ qù tī zúqiú.
exampleSentences.meaning: After school, they go to play football together.

confusableCharacter.guidance: 足 begins with 口, while 走 begins with 土 above a similar spreading lower form.

seo.title: 足 (zú) Stroke Order, Meaning & Examples
seo.h1: How to Write 足 (zú): Stroke Order, Meaning & Examples
seo.description: Write 足 (zú) in seven strokes. Compare its upper 口 with 走 and distinguish the foot sense in 足球 from enough in 足够.

hsk.note: Local HSK 2.0 Level 3 vocabulary includes 节目 (jié mù). This is word-family evidence, not a standalone level assignment for this character.

importance: 目 helps learners read and write eye; item. Start with 目的 (purpose) and compare the other everyday uses below.

components.explanation: A tall enclosure contains two horizontal lines, creating three stacked spaces. It has one more inner horizontal than 日.

readingNotes: Read 目 as mù in this guide. Compare 目的 (mùdì) and 目录 (mùlù) to practise the sound in complete words.
usageTitle: Using 目 in words and sentences
usage: 目 is the eye character, but everyday speech normally uses 眼睛 for eyes. It also appears in 目的, 目录 and 题目.
writingTip: Make the enclosure tall and narrow, space its two inner horizontals evenly, and close the bottom after writing them.

exampleSentences.meaning: This question is difficult.
Please look at the contents first.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 你这次旅行的目的是什么？
exampleSentences.pinyin: Nǐ zhè cì lǚxíng de mùdì shì shénme?
exampleSentences.meaning: What is the purpose of your trip?

confusableCharacter.guidance: 目 contains two inner horizontals, whereas 日 contains one.

seo.title: 目 (mù) Stroke Order, Meaning & Examples
seo.h1: How to Write 目 (mù): Stroke Order, Meaning & Examples
seo.description: Learn 目 (mù), the eye character, and compare its two inner lines with 日. Practise 目的, 目录, 题目, and 目光 with examples.

hsk.note: Local HSK 2.0 Level 3 vocabulary includes 耳朵 (ěr duo). This is word-family evidence, not a standalone level assignment for this character.

importance: 耳 helps learners read and write ear. Start with 耳朵 (ear) and compare the other everyday uses below.

components.explanation: A top horizontal covers two uprights and short inner lines. The right upright extends below the lower crossing line, so the outline is not a closed box.

readingNotes: Read 耳 as ěr in this guide. Compare 耳朵 (ěrduo) and 耳机 (ěrjī) to practise the sound in complete words.
usageTitle: Using 耳 in words and sentences
usage: 耳 appears in 耳朵 for ear and 耳机 for headphones. Use the complete word 耳朵 in ordinary conversation about ears.
writingTip: Keep the inner horizontals short and let the right vertical extend below the lower crossing line, leaving clear interior spaces.

exampleSentences.meaning: My ears are cold.
She is wearing headphones.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 请不要把耳机声音开得太大。
exampleSentences.pinyin: Qǐng bú yào bǎ ěrjī shēngyīn kāi de tài dà.
exampleSentences.meaning: Please do not turn the headphones up too loud.

confusableCharacter.guidance: 耳 has an extended right vertical and does not form the closed box of 目.

seo.title: 耳 (ěr) Stroke Order, Meaning & Examples
seo.h1: How to Write 耳 (ěr): Stroke Order, Meaning & Examples
seo.description: Write 耳 (ěr) in six strokes, keeping its extended right vertical clear. Learn 耳朵, 耳机, and related words without confusing 耳 with 目.

hsk.note: Local HSK 3.0 Level 3 vocabulary includes 心 (xīn).

importance: 心 helps learners read and write heart; mind. Start with 开心 (happy) and compare the other everyday uses below.

components.explanation: A shallow curved hook is surrounded by three dots at different heights. The dots are separate marks, not a continuous upper line.

readingNotes: Read 心 as xīn in this guide. Compare 开心 (kāixīn) and 小心 (xiǎoxīn) to practise the sound in complete words.
usageTitle: Using 心 in words and sentences
usage: 心 builds words for feelings and attention. 开心 means happy, 小心 means be careful, and 关心 means care about.
writingTip: Give the curved hook enough width and keep the three dots separate, placing them at different heights around the curve.

exampleSentences.meaning: I am happy.

exampleSentences.pinyin: Xià yǔ le, xiǎoxīn lù huá.
exampleSentences.meaning: It is raining; be careful of the slippery road.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 老师关心每个学生的学习。
exampleSentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī guānxīn měi ge xuésheng de xuéxí.
exampleSentences.meaning: The teacher cares about every student's learning.

confusableCharacter.guidance: 心 has separate dots; 必 adds a long crossing slant through the centre.

seo.title: 心 (xīn) Stroke Order, Meaning & Examples
seo.h1: How to Write 心 (xīn): Stroke Order, Meaning & Examples
seo.description: Learn 心 (xīn) stroke order and its three separate dots. Practise 开心, 小心, 关心, and 中心, and compare the form with 必.

hsk.note: Local HSK 2.0 Level 4 vocabulary includes 火 (huǒ).

importance: 火 helps learners read and write fire. Start with 火车 (train) and compare the other everyday uses below.

components.explanation: Two short upper side strokes flank a central pair of falling strokes. The lower strokes spread into a wider base than the upper marks.

readingNotes: Read 火 as huǒ in this guide. Compare 火车 (huǒchē) and 火山 (huǒshān) to practise the sound in complete words.
usageTitle: Using 火 in words and sentences
usage: 火 means fire and appears in 火车, 火山 and 火锅. These compounds name a train, volcano and hotpot rather than fire alone.
writingTip: Keep the short upper strokes apart from the central falling pair, and let the lower part spread without adding a horizontal.

exampleSentences.meaning: I am going to Beijing by train.
We are having hotpot tonight.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 这座火山附近有很多游客。
exampleSentences.pinyin: Zhè zuò huǒshān fùjìn yǒu hěn duō yóukè.
exampleSentences.meaning: There are many visitors near this volcano.

confusableCharacter.guidance: 火 adds two short upper strokes, whereas 人 consists of only two falling strokes.

seo.title: 火 (huǒ) Stroke Order, Meaning & Examples
seo.h1: How to Write 火 (huǒ): Stroke Order, Meaning & Examples
seo.description: Write 火 (huǒ), keeping its upper marks distinct from 人. Explore the meanings of 火车, 火山, 火锅, and 大火 with stroke diagrams.

hsk.note: Local HSK 3.0 Level 1 vocabulary includes 山 (shān).

importance: 山 helps learners read and write mountain. Start with 爬山 (climb a mountain) and compare the other everyday uses below.

components.explanation: A tall central upright rises above two side peaks joined along the bottom. The outline has one level of peaks, unlike the stacked form of 出.

readingNotes: Read 山 as shān in this guide. Compare 爬山 (páshān) and 山上 (shānshang) to practise the sound in complete words.
usageTitle: Using 山 in words and sentences
usage: 山 names mountains and appears in activities and scenery. 爬山 means climb a mountain and 山水 refers to landscape.
writingTip: Start with the central vertical, then form the lower-left turn and right side; keep the central peak taller than both sides.

exampleSentences.meaning: There are trees on the mountain.
We are going mountain climbing this weekend.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 从山上可以看见整个城市。
exampleSentences.pinyin: Cóng shānshang kěyǐ kànjiàn zhěng ge chéngshì.
exampleSentences.meaning: You can see the whole city from the mountain.

confusableCharacter.guidance: 山 has one set of peaks, while 出 stacks two connected peak-like shapes.

seo.title: 山 (shān) Stroke Order, Meaning & Examples
seo.h1: How to Write 山 (shān): Stroke Order, Meaning & Examples
seo.description: Learn 山 (shān) in three strokes and compare it with 出. Practise 爬山, 山上, 火山, and 山水 using mountain-related sentences.

hsk.note: Local HSK 3.0 Level 3 vocabulary includes 土 (tǔ).

importance: 土 helps learners read and write soil; earth. Start with 土地 (land) and compare the other everyday uses below.

components.explanation: A short upper horizontal crosses a vertical that meets a longer bottom horizontal. The relative line lengths distinguish 土 from 士.

readingNotes: Read 土 as tǔ in this guide. Compare 土地 (tǔdì) and 泥土 (nítǔ) to practise the sound in complete words.
usageTitle: Using 土 in words and sentences
usage: 土 refers to soil or earth in 土地 and 泥土. 土豆 means potato, so learn the whole compound rather than translating soil literally.
writingTip: Draw the short upper horizontal first; make the bottom line longer and stop the vertical at the base instead of extending below it.

exampleSentences.meaning: I like eating potatoes.
Flowers need water and soil.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 雨后，花园里的泥土很湿。
exampleSentences.pinyin: Yǔ hòu, huāyuán lǐ de nítǔ hěn shī.
exampleSentences.meaning: After the rain, the garden soil is wet.

confusableCharacter.guidance: 土 has a longer bottom line, whereas 士 has a longer top line.

seo.title: 土 (tǔ) Stroke Order, Meaning & Examples
seo.h1: How to Write 土 (tǔ): Stroke Order, Meaning & Examples
seo.description: Write 土 (tǔ) with a longer bottom line than 士. Learn soil and land vocabulary, including 泥土 and 土地, plus the compound 土豆.

hsk.note: Local HSK 2.0 Level 5 vocabulary includes 木头 (mù tou). This is word-family evidence, not a standalone level assignment for this character.

importance: 木 helps learners read and write wood; tree component. Start with 木头 (wood) and compare the other everyday uses below.

components.explanation: A central cross is accompanied by left- and right-falling strokes below it. There is no extra short horizontal near the base as in 本.

readingNotes: Read 木 as mù in this guide. Compare 木头 (mùtou) and 木门 (mùmén) to practise the sound in complete words.
usageTitle: Using 木 in words and sentences
usage: 木 commonly means wood in compounds. 木头 is wood, 木门 is a wooden door, and 树木 means trees rather than timber alone.
writingTip: Place the crossbar above the centre and keep the vertical straight while the two lower strokes spread out to either side.

exampleSentences.meaning: This is a wooden door.
The table is made of wood.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 我们应该保护森林里的树木。
exampleSentences.pinyin: Wǒmen yīnggāi bǎohù sēnlín lǐ de shùmù.
exampleSentences.meaning: We should protect forest trees.

confusableCharacter.guidance: 木 has no extra short line near its base; 本 includes that line.

seo.title: 木 (mù) Stroke Order, Meaning & Examples
seo.h1: How to Write 木 (mù): Stroke Order, Meaning & Examples
seo.description: Learn 木 (mù) stroke order and compare 木 with 本. Practise words for wood, wooden objects, and trees, including 木头 and 树木.

hsk.note: Local HSK 3.0 Level 6 vocabulary includes 田 (tián).

importance: 田 helps learners read and write field; farmland. Start with 田地 (fields) and compare the other everyday uses below.

components.explanation: An outer square encloses a horizontal and vertical cross. The centre line stays inside the square rather than projecting above it as in 由.

readingNotes: Read 田 as tián in this guide. Compare 田地 (tiándì) and 农田 (nóngtián) to practise the sound in complete words.
usageTitle: Using 田 in words and sentences
usage: 田 refers to cultivated fields in 农田 and 田地. 田字格 names a handwriting layout divided into four spaces like 田.
writingTip: Leave room inside the outer square for a centred cross, keep all four spaces balanced, and close the bottom border last.

exampleSentences.meaning: There is water in the farmland.
We use cross-guided grids to write Chinese characters.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 这片田地每年都种水稻。
exampleSentences.pinyin: Zhè piàn tiándì měi nián dōu zhòng shuǐdào.
exampleSentences.meaning: Rice is grown in this field every year.

confusableCharacter.guidance: 田 keeps its central vertical inside the box, while 由 extends it above the top.

seo.title: 田 (tián) Stroke Order, Meaning & Examples
seo.h1: How to Write 田 (tián): Stroke Order, Meaning & Examples
seo.description: Write 田 (tián), balance its four inner spaces, and compare it with 由. Learn field vocabulary and why handwriting grids are called 田字格.

hsk.note: Local HSK 3.0 Level 3 vocabulary includes 力 (lì).

importance: 力 helps learners read and write strength; effort. Start with 力气 (physical strength) and compare the other everyday uses below.

components.explanation: A turning hooked stroke is crossed by a left-falling stroke whose upper end rises above the horizontal. That crossing differs from 刀.

readingNotes: Read 力 as lì in this guide. Compare 力气 (lìqi) and 努力 (nǔlì) to practise the sound in complete words.
usageTitle: Using 力 in words and sentences
usage: 力 describes strength or effort in compounds. 努力 means work hard, 能力 means ability, and 力气 is physical strength.
writingTip: Form the turn and hook first, then start the falling stroke above the horizontal so that its crossing remains clear.

exampleSentences.meaning: He is strong.
I want to study hard.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 练习可以提高你的表达能力。
exampleSentences.pinyin: Liànxí kěyǐ tígāo nǐ de biǎodá nénglì.
exampleSentences.meaning: Practice can improve your ability to express yourself.

confusableCharacter.guidance: 力 has a falling stroke starting above the horizontal, whereas 刀 keeps its inner fall below the top.

seo.title: 力 (lì) Stroke Order, Meaning & Examples
seo.h1: How to Write 力 (lì): Stroke Order, Meaning & Examples
seo.description: Learn 力 (lì) in two strokes and compare its crossing with 刀. Distinguish strength in 力气 from effort in 努力 and ability in 能力.

hsk.note: Local HSK 3.0 Level 1 vocabulary includes 女 (nǚ).

importance: 女 helps learners read and write female; woman. Start with 女人 (woman) and compare the other everyday uses below.

components.explanation: Three crossing strokes form an open lower shape. A final horizontal balances the curved strokes; there is no enclosed pair of dots as in 母.

readingNotes: Read 女 as nǚ in this guide. Compare 女人 (nǚrén) and 女儿 (nǚ'ér) to practise the sound in complete words.
usageTitle: Using 女 in words and sentences
usage: 女 appears in words for women, girls and daughters. 女儿 means daughter and 女生 means a female student; the second character changes the role.
writingTip: Keep the crossing strokes open and finish with a horizontal that balances the lower part, avoiding a closed upper loop.

exampleSentences.meaning: She is my daughter.
That girl is reading.

exampleSentences.pinyin: Wǒmen bān yǒu shíwǔ ge nǚshēng.
exampleSentences.meaning: There are fifteen female students in our class.

confusableCharacter.guidance: 女 has neither the enclosing shape nor the two inner dots of 母.

seo.title: 女 (nǚ) Stroke Order, Meaning & Examples
seo.h1: How to Write 女 (nǚ): Stroke Order, Meaning & Examples
seo.description: Write 女 (nǚ) in three strokes. Compare 女 with 母 and learn the different roles expressed by 女儿, 女生, 女孩, and 女人.

hsk.note: Local HSK 3.0 Level 1 vocabulary includes 子 (zǐ).

importance: 子 helps learners read and write child; noun suffix. Start with 儿子 (son) and compare the other everyday uses below.

components.explanation: An upper turn leads into a central hooked stroke crossed by the last horizontal. The final horizontal is absent in the similar character 了.

readingNotes: 子 is zǐ as an independent character and in 子女 (zǐnǚ). In 儿子 (érzi), 孩子 (háizi), and 桌子 (zhuōzi), the noun suffix is normally unstressed neutral zi.
usageTitle: Using 子 in words and sentences
usage: 子 is zǐ in 子女 but neutral zi in noun suffixes such as 儿子, 桌子 and 孩子. The suffix does not always mean child.
writingTip: Keep the hook centred under the upper turn, then extend the final horizontal on both sides without adding an inner dot.

exampleSentences.meaning: This is my son.
The children are at school.

exampleSentences.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ shū fàng zài zhuōzi shàng.
exampleSentences.meaning: Please put the book on the table.

confusableCharacter.guidance: 子 has a final horizontal across the lower part; 了 does not.

seo.title: 子 (zǐ) Stroke Order, Meaning & Examples
seo.h1: How to Write 子 (zǐ): Stroke Order, Meaning & Examples
seo.description: Learn 子 stroke order and when to read it zǐ or neutral zi. Compare 子 with 了 and practise 子女, 孩子, 儿子, and 桌子.

hsk.note: Local HSK 2.0 Level 4 vocabulary includes 父亲 (fù qīn). This is word-family evidence, not a standalone level assignment for this character.

importance: 父 helps learners read and write father. Start with 父亲 (father) and compare the other everyday uses below.

components.explanation: Two short upper strokes sit above a crossing lower pair. The upper pair is separate, unlike the dot-and-horizontal top of 文.

readingNotes: Read 父 as fù in this guide. Compare 父亲 (fùqīn) and 父母 (fùmǔ) to practise the sound in complete words.
usageTitle: Using 父 in words and sentences
usage: 父 is used in formal family words such as 父亲 and 父母. Everyday conversation often uses 爸爸 for dad; 父母 means both parents.
writingTip: Keep the two upper strokes short and apart, then broaden the lower crossing strokes without joining the top into a roof.

exampleSentences.meaning: This is my father.

exampleSentences.pinyin: Wǒ hé fùmǔ zhù zài yìqǐ.
exampleSentences.meaning: I live with my parents.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 周末，我常常给父亲打电话。
exampleSentences.pinyin: Zhōumò, wǒ chángcháng gěi fùqīn dǎ diànhuà.
exampleSentences.meaning: I often call my father on weekends.

confusableCharacter.guidance: 父 has two separate upper strokes, while 文 has a dot and horizontal above its lower crossing.

seo.title: 父 (fù) Stroke Order, Meaning & Examples
seo.h1: How to Write 父 (fù): Stroke Order, Meaning & Examples
seo.description: Write 父 (fù) in four strokes and compare its upper marks with 文. Learn 父亲, 父母, 祖父, and 父子 in family contexts.

hsk.note: Local HSK 3.0 Level 6 vocabulary includes 母 (mǔ).

importance: 母 helps learners read and write mother. Start with 母亲 (mother) and compare the other everyday uses below.

components.explanation: An enclosing form is crossed by a horizontal and contains two dots. Its interior and outline differ from the open crossing strokes of 女.

readingNotes: Read 母 as mǔ in this guide. Compare 母亲 (mǔqīn) and 父母 (fùmǔ) to practise the sound in complete words.
usageTitle: Using 母 in words and sentences
usage: 母 occurs in 母亲, 父母 and 母语. 母亲 means mother and 母语 means native language, not a language spoken only by mothers.
writingTip: Leave enough space within the outer turns for both dots, and draw the central horizontal clearly across the enclosing form.

exampleSentences.meaning: She is my mother.
Chinese is his native language.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 我希望父母每天都健康快乐。
exampleSentences.pinyin: Wǒ xīwàng fùmǔ měitiān dōu jiànkāng kuàilè.
exampleSentences.meaning: I hope my parents are healthy and happy every day.

confusableCharacter.guidance: 母 is the lower component of 每, but has no additional strokes above it.

seo.title: 母 (mǔ) Stroke Order, Meaning & Examples
seo.h1: How to Write 母 (mǔ): Stroke Order, Meaning & Examples
seo.description: Learn 母 (mǔ) stroke order, preserving both inner dots. Practise 母亲, 父母, 祖母, and the extended meaning in 母语.

hsk.note: Local HSK 3.0 Level 4 vocabulary includes 王 (wáng).

importance: 王 helps learners read and write king; surname Wang. Start with 国王 (king) and compare the other everyday uses below.

components.explanation: Three horizontals are joined by a central vertical. The bottom horizontal is broad, and there is no separate lower-right dot.

readingNotes: Use wáng for king and the surname Wang. Capitalise the surname as Wáng in Pinyin, as in Wáng lǎoshī; keep the rising second tone in both uses.
usageTitle: Using 王 in words and sentences
usage: 王 means king in 国王 and is also a surname. Capitalise Wáng for a person's name; 王老师 is Teacher Wang.
writingTip: Space the three horizontals evenly, join them with a straight central vertical, and finish with a broad base without a dot.

exampleSentences.meaning: His surname is Wang.
Teacher Wang teaches us Chinese.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 这个故事里的国王很善良。
exampleSentences.pinyin: Zhège gùshi lǐ de guówáng hěn shànliáng.
exampleSentences.meaning: The king in this story is kind.

confusableCharacter.guidance: 王 has no lower-right dot; 玉 adds one and means jade.

seo.title: 王 (wáng) Stroke Order, Meaning & Examples
seo.h1: How to Write 王 (wáng): Stroke Order, Meaning & Examples
seo.description: Write 王 (wáng) and distinguish it from 玉. Learn the king sense in 国王 and how the surname Wáng is used in 王老师.

hsk.note: Local HSK 3.0 Level 4 vocabulary includes 玉 (yù).

importance: 玉 helps learners read and write jade. Start with 玉米 (corn) and compare the other everyday uses below.

components.explanation: The main body resembles 王, with a separate dot beside its lower-right part. The dot is outside the central vertical, not an inner crossbar.

readingNotes: Read 玉 as yù in this guide. Compare 玉米 (yùmǐ) and 玉石 (yùshí) to practise the sound in complete words.
usageTitle: Using 玉 in words and sentences
usage: 玉 names jade and appears in jewellery vocabulary. 玉米 means corn, a food word whose meaning is not simply jade.
writingTip: Build the three horizontals and the central vertical, then place the lower-right dot separately from the bottom line.

exampleSentences.meaning: I like eating corn.
This piece of jade is beautiful.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 博物馆里有很多古代玉器。
exampleSentences.pinyin: Bówùguǎn lǐ yǒu hěn duō gǔdài yùqì.
exampleSentences.meaning: There are many ancient jade objects in the museum.

confusableCharacter.guidance: 玉 has a lower-right dot, whereas 王 does not; that dot distinguishes jade from king.

seo.title: 玉 (yù) Stroke Order, Meaning & Examples
seo.h1: How to Write 玉 (yù): Stroke Order, Meaning & Examples
seo.description: Learn 玉 (yù) in five strokes and distinguish jade from 王 by its dot. Practise 玉石, 玉器, 白玉, and the food word 玉米.

hsk.note: Local HSK 2.0 Level 2 vocabulary includes 白 (bái).

importance: 白 helps learners read and write white; clear. Start with 白色 (white) and compare the other everyday uses below.

components.explanation: A short slant rises above a box containing one inner horizontal. Unlike 百, there is no separate horizontal cap above that slant.

readingNotes: Read 白 as bái in this guide. Compare 白色 (báisè) and 白天 (báitiān) to practise the sound in complete words.
usageTitle: Using 白 in words and sentences
usage: 白 describes white in 白色 and 白纸. 白天 means daytime, while 明白 means understand; whole words carry different senses.
writingTip: Keep the short upper slant visible and the inner horizontal separate from the box edges, leaving open space above and below it.

exampleSentences.pinyin: Zhè zhāng zhǐ shì báisè de.
exampleSentences.meaning: This paper is white.
I understand now.
He works during the day and studies at night.

confusableCharacter.guidance: 白 starts with a short slant; 百 has an additional horizontal cap above a similar lower box.

seo.title: 白 (bái) Stroke Order, Meaning & Examples
seo.h1: How to Write 白 (bái): Stroke Order, Meaning & Examples
seo.description: Write 白 (bái) and compare it with 百. Learn white in 白色 and 白纸, daytime in 白天, and understanding in 明白.

hsk.note: Local HSK 2.0 Level 2 vocabulary includes 红 (hóng).

importance: 红 helps learners read and write red. Start with 红色 (red) and compare the other everyday uses below.

components.explanation: The narrow silk radical 纟 stands to the left of 工. The two parts remain separated, and 工 keeps its two horizontals and central vertical.

readingNotes: Read 红 as hóng in this guide. Compare 红色 (hóngsè) and 红灯 (hóngdēng) to practise the sound in complete words.
usageTitle: Using 红 in words and sentences
usage: 红 describes red objects and signals. 红灯 is a red light, but 红茶 is called black tea in English rather than red tea.
writingTip: Keep the silk radical narrow on the left and give 工 a clear upright centre, leaving a small gap between the two components.

exampleSentences.pinyin: Zhè duǒ huā shì hóngsè de.
exampleSentences.meaning: This flower is red.

exampleSentences.pinyin: Hóngdēng liàng le, qǐng tíng xià.
exampleSentences.meaning: The red light is on; please stop.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 我想喝一杯不加糖的红茶。
exampleSentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng hē yì bēi bù jiā táng de hóngchá.
exampleSentences.meaning: I would like black tea without sugar.

confusableCharacter.guidance: 红 has 纟 on the left, whereas 江 has 氵; both have 工 on the right.

seo.title: 红 (hóng) Stroke Order, Meaning & Examples
seo.h1: How to Write 红 (hóng): Stroke Order, Meaning & Examples
seo.description: Learn 红 (hóng) with 纟 beside 工. Practise red objects and traffic lights, and understand why 红茶 is called black tea in English.

hsk.note: Local HSK 2.0 Level 3 vocabulary includes 蓝 (lán).

importance: 蓝 helps learners read and write blue. Start with 蓝色 (blue) and compare the other everyday uses below.

components.explanation: The grass radical 艹 spans the top of 监. The lower component ends in a broad 皿 base with several small spaces above it.

readingNotes: Read 蓝 as lán in this guide. Compare 蓝色 (lánsè) and 蓝天 (lántiān) to practise the sound in complete words.
usageTitle: Using 蓝 in words and sentences
usage: 蓝 is the modern colour word in 蓝色 and 蓝天. 蓝图 can mean blueprint or plan; 篮球 uses a different character.
writingTip: Keep 艹 shallow, leave enough height for 监, and separate the short strokes above the broad 皿 base.

exampleSentences.meaning: The sky is blue.
We can see blue sky today.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 她穿着蓝色的衣服去学校。
exampleSentences.pinyin: Tā chuān zhe lánsè de yīfu qù xuéxiào.
exampleSentences.meaning: She is wearing blue clothes to school.

confusableCharacter.guidance: 蓝 has the grass radical 艹, while 篮 has the bamboo radical ⺮ above a similar lower part.

seo.title: 蓝 (lán) Stroke Order, Meaning & Examples
seo.h1: How to Write 蓝 (lán): Stroke Order, Meaning & Examples
seo.description: Write 蓝 (lán), with 艹 above 监, and distinguish it from 篮. Practise blue in 蓝色 and 蓝天, plus the extended meaning of 蓝图.

hsk.note: Local HSK 2.0 Level 3 vocabulary includes 绿 (lǜ).

importance: 绿 helps learners read and write green. Start with 绿色 (green) and compare the other everyday uses below.

components.explanation: The narrow left radical 纟 sits beside 录. The right component has a compact upper form and several separated lower strokes.

readingNotes: The common colour reading is lǜ, with ü and a falling fourth tone, as in 绿色 (lǜsè). The less common lù reading occurs in fixed words such as 绿林 (lùlín).
usageTitle: Using 绿 in words and sentences
usage: 绿 is lǜ in everyday colour words such as 绿色 and 绿茶. A less common lù reading occurs in fixed expressions; this guide teaches the colour sense.
writingTip: Keep 纟 narrow and separate it from 录; leave the lower strokes on the right apart rather than compressing them into a block.

exampleSentences.meaning: The leaves are green.
I like drinking green tea.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 等绿灯亮了，我们再过马路。
exampleSentences.pinyin: Děng lǜdēng liàng le, wǒmen zài guò mǎlù.
exampleSentences.meaning: We will cross when the green light comes on.

confusableCharacter.guidance: 绿 adds 纟 to the left of 录; the radical distinguishes green from the bare component.

seo.title: 绿 (lǜ) Stroke Order, Meaning & Examples
seo.h1: How to Write 绿 (lǜ): Stroke Order, Meaning & Examples
seo.description: Learn 绿 (lǜ) stroke order and its common colour reading. Practise 绿色, 绿茶, 绿灯, and 绿叶 while comparing 绿 with 录.

hsk.note: Local HSK 3.0 Level 3 vocabulary includes 金 (jīn).

importance: 金 helps learners read and write gold; metal. Start with 黄金 (gold) and compare the other everyday uses below.

components.explanation: A broad 人-shaped cover sits above a central upright, horizontals, and two lower dots. Those dots distinguish the lower form from 全.

readingNotes: Read 金 as jīn in this guide. Compare 黄金 (huángjīn) and 金色 (jīnsè) to practise the sound in complete words.
usageTitle: Using 金 in words and sentences
usage: 金 can mean gold or metal. 黄金 names gold, 金色 describes a golden colour, and 奖金 means a cash bonus.
writingTip: Spread the top cover over the lower part, keep the two lower dots distinct, and finish with a level bottom horizontal.

exampleSentences.pinyin: Zhè tiáo yú shì jīnsè de.
exampleSentences.meaning: This fish is golden.
Iron is a kind of metal.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 她把获得的奖金存了起来。
exampleSentences.pinyin: Tā bǎ huòdé de jiǎngjīn cún le qǐlái.
exampleSentences.meaning: She saved the bonus she received.

confusableCharacter.guidance: 金 includes two lower dots, whereas 全 has a simpler 王-like lower part.

seo.title: 金 (jīn) Stroke Order, Meaning & Examples
seo.h1: How to Write 金 (jīn): Stroke Order, Meaning & Examples
seo.description: Write 金 (jīn) in eight strokes and compare it with 全. Learn gold, metal, golden colour, and the cash-bonus meaning of 奖金.

hsk.note: Local HSK 3.0 Level 1 vocabulary includes 雨 (yǔ).

importance: 雨 helps learners read and write rain. Start with 下雨 (rain) and compare the other everyday uses below.

components.explanation: A top line covers a frame divided by a central vertical. Four dots occupy the interior, two on each side of the centre.

readingNotes: Read 雨 as yǔ, a third tone, in 下雨 (xiàyǔ) and 雨水 (yǔshuǐ). The literary verb reading yù is not the everyday weather reading used in these examples.
usageTitle: Using 雨 in words and sentences
usage: 雨 is yǔ for rain in 下雨 and 雨水. 下雨 is the everyday verb phrase for raining; the literary verb reading yù is not the sense taught here.
writingTip: Leave space inside the frame for four separate dots, two on each side of the central vertical, without turning them into crossbars.

exampleSentences.meaning: It is raining today.
Please take a raincoat.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 如果明天下雨，我们就在家看书。
exampleSentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ míngtiān xià yǔ, wǒmen jiù zài jiā kàn shū.
exampleSentences.meaning: If it rains tomorrow, we will read at home.

confusableCharacter.guidance: 雨 has four inner dots and a central vertical; 两 has a different interior.

seo.title: 雨 (yǔ) Stroke Order, Meaning & Examples
seo.h1: How to Write 雨 (yǔ): Stroke Order, Meaning & Examples
seo.description: Learn 雨 (yǔ), including its four inner dots. Use 下雨, 雨水, 雨衣, and 雨天 in weather sentences and compare 雨 with 两.

hsk.note: Local HSK 2.0 Level 3 vocabulary includes 云 (yún).

importance: 云 helps learners read and write cloud. Start with 白云 (white clouds) and compare the other everyday uses below.

components.explanation: Two horizontals sit above an open 厶 form. The upper part has no crossing vertical, unlike the 土 at the top of 去.

readingNotes: Read 云 as yún in this guide. Compare 白云 (báiyún) and 多云 (duōyún) to practise the sound in complete words.
usageTitle: Using 云 in words and sentences
usage: 云 names clouds in 白云 and 乌云. 多云 describes cloudy weather; modern words such as 云计算 extend the image to computing.
writingTip: Keep the two upper horizontals parallel, make the lower one longer, and leave the lower 厶 open instead of closing a triangle.

exampleSentences.meaning: There are white clouds in the sky.
It is cloudy today but not raining.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 山顶上的云海非常漂亮。
exampleSentences.pinyin: Shāndǐng shàng de yúnhǎi fēicháng piàoliang.
exampleSentences.meaning: The sea of clouds at the mountaintop is beautiful.

confusableCharacter.guidance: 云 has two top horizontals, whereas 去 has 土 above the lower 厶.

seo.title: 云 (yún) Stroke Order, Meaning & Examples
seo.h1: How to Write 云 (yún): Stroke Order, Meaning & Examples
seo.description: Write 云 (yún) in four strokes and compare it with 去. Learn 白云, 乌云, 多云, and 云海 through weather and landscape examples.

hsk.note: Local HSK 3.0 Level 1 vocabulary includes 风 (fēng).

importance: 风 helps learners read and write wind. Start with 大风 (strong wind) and compare the other everyday uses below.

components.explanation: A loose outer cover surrounds two crossed strokes and stays open at the bottom. The inner cross differs from 又 inside 凤.

readingNotes: Read 风 as fēng in this guide. Compare 大风 (dàfēng) and 风景 (fēngjǐng) to practise the sound in complete words.
usageTitle: Using 风 in words and sentences
usage: 风 names wind and also appears in words for scenery and style. 风景 means scenery and 风格 means style, not weather.
writingTip: Keep the outer cover open at the bottom, place the inner crossing within it, and leave room for the hook on the right.

exampleSentences.meaning: It is very windy today.
The scenery here is lovely.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 外面正在刮风，请把窗户关上。
exampleSentences.pinyin: Wàimian zhèngzài guā fēng, qǐng bǎ chuānghu guān shàng.
exampleSentences.meaning: It is windy outside; please close the window.

confusableCharacter.guidance: 风 contains crossed strokes, while 凤 contains 又 inside a similar outer frame.

hsk.note: Local HSK 3.0 Level 1 vocabulary includes 电 (diàn).

importance: 电 helps learners read and write electricity. Start with 电话 (telephone) and compare the other everyday uses below.

components.explanation: The upper box-like form is crossed by a central stroke that extends below it and turns into a hook. That extended hook is absent in 田.

readingNotes: Read 电 as diàn in this guide. Compare 电话 (diànhuà) and 电脑 (diànnǎo) to practise the sound in complete words.
usageTitle: Using 电 in words and sentences
usage: 电 names electricity and forms words for powered devices. 电话 is telephone, 电脑 is computer, and 电影 means film.
writingTip: Carry the central stroke through the upper box and turn it into a hook below, extending clearly beyond the enclosure.

exampleSentences.meaning: I am calling my mother.

exampleSentences.pinyin: Zhè tái diànnǎo shì xīn de.
exampleSentences.meaning: This computer is new.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 今天晚上我们一起去看电影。
exampleSentences.pinyin: Jīntiān wǎnshang wǒmen yìqǐ qù kàn diànyǐng.
exampleSentences.meaning: We are going to see a film tonight.

confusableCharacter.guidance: 电 extends its central stroke below the box into a hook, while 田 keeps the cross inside.

seo.h1: How to Write 电 (diàn): Stroke Order, Meaning & Examples

hsk.note: Local HSK 3.0 Level 1 vocabulary includes 车 (chē).

importance: 车 helps learners read and write vehicle; car. Start with 汽车 (car) and compare the other everyday uses below.

components.explanation: Horizontals and a turning stroke are joined by a central vertical. The lower part has a crossing line rather than the side strokes found in 东.

readingNotes: Use chē, a level first tone, in 汽车 (qìchē), 火车 (huǒchē), and 车站 (chēzhàn). In Chinese chess the rook is also called 车, pronounced jū.
usageTitle: Using 车 in words and sentences
usage: 车 is chē in transport words such as 汽车 and 火车. In Chinese chess it can be jū for the rook; this guide uses the vehicle reading.
writingTip: Keep the turning stroke distinct from the lower horizontal, then finish the central vertical through the crossings.

exampleSentences.meaning: Where is the station?
I ride a bicycle to school.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 这辆汽车可以坐五个人。
exampleSentences.pinyin: Zhè liàng qìchē kěyǐ zuò wǔ ge rén.
exampleSentences.meaning: This car can seat five people.

confusableCharacter.guidance: 车 has a central vertical crossing horizontals, whereas 东 has separate lower side strokes.

hsk.note: Local HSK 2.0 Level 3 vocabulary includes 马 (mǎ).

importance: 马 helps learners read and write horse. Start with 马上 (immediately) and compare the other everyday uses below.

components.explanation: The simplified form has a compact upper turn, an outer hooked turn, and a separate lower horizontal. There is no dot inside the upper part.

readingNotes: Read 马 as mǎ in this guide. Compare 马上 (mǎshàng) and 马路 (mǎlù) to practise the sound in complete words.
usageTitle: Using 马 in words and sentences
usage: 马 names a horse, but compounds can have other meanings. 马上 means immediately and 马路 means road, not riding a horse.
writingTip: Follow the turns as continuous strokes and keep the lower horizontal separate from the hook; do not add the inner dot of 鸟.

exampleSentences.meaning: I want to ride a horse.
I will be right back.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 过马路的时候，要先看两边。
exampleSentences.pinyin: Guò mǎlù de shíhou, yào xiān kàn liǎng biān.
exampleSentences.meaning: Look both ways before crossing the road.

confusableCharacter.guidance: 马 lacks the inner dot and extra upper slant found in 鸟.

hsk.note: Local HSK 2.0 Level 3 vocabulary includes 鸟 (niǎo).

importance: 鸟 helps learners read and write bird. Start with 小鸟 (small bird) and compare the other everyday uses below.

components.explanation: A short upper slant and enclosed dot sit above the lower body and final horizontal. The inner dot is missing in the similar character 乌.

readingNotes: Read 鸟 as niǎo in this guide. Compare 小鸟 (xiǎoniǎo) and 鸟类 (niǎolèi) to practise the sound in complete words.
usageTitle: Using 鸟 in words and sentences
usage: 鸟 is the general character for bird. 小鸟 means a small bird and 鸟类 means birds as a class; 只 is a common measure word.
writingTip: Keep the dot inside the upper part visible, then leave room below for the turning stroke and separate final horizontal.

exampleSentences.pinyin: Shù shàng yǒu yì zhī niǎo.
exampleSentences.meaning: There is a bird in the tree.
The little bird is singing.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 我们不要打扰树上的鸟巢。
exampleSentences.pinyin: Wǒmen bú yào dǎrǎo shù shàng de niǎocháo.
exampleSentences.meaning: We should not disturb the nest in the tree.

confusableCharacter.guidance: 鸟 has an inner dot, whereas 乌 does not; preserve that small mark.

hsk.note: Local HSK 2.0 Level 2 vocabulary includes 鱼 (yú).

importance: 鱼 helps learners read and write fish. Start with 金鱼 (goldfish) and compare the other everyday uses below.

components.explanation: A compact head sits above a field-like middle and a broad final horizontal. The simplified form has a line at the bottom, not the dots of 魚.

readingNotes: Read 鱼 as yú in this guide. Compare 金鱼 (jīnyú) and 钓鱼 (diàoyú) to practise the sound in complete words.
usageTitle: Using 鱼 in words and sentences
usage: 鱼 names fish as animals and food. 金鱼 is goldfish and 钓鱼 means fish with a rod; 条 commonly counts fish.
writingTip: Keep the upper head compact, leave space for the middle cross, and draw a broad final horizontal beneath the body.

exampleSentences.meaning: There are fish in the water.
Grandpa likes fishing.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 这条金鱼在水里游来游去。
exampleSentences.pinyin: Zhè tiáo jīnyú zài shuǐ lǐ yóu lái yóu qù.
exampleSentences.meaning: This goldfish swims back and forth in the water.

confusableCharacter.guidance: 鱼 has a field-like middle and broad base; 角 has a different open lower structure.

hsk.note: Local HSK 2.0 Level 3 vocabulary includes 米 (mǐ).

importance: 米 helps learners read and write rice; metre. Start with 大米 (rice) and compare the other everyday uses below.

components.explanation: Two upper short strokes flank a central cross above two lower falling strokes. Compared with 木, the upper pair adds two extra marks.

readingNotes: Read 米 as mǐ in this guide. Compare 大米 (dàmǐ) and 米饭 (mǐfàn) to practise the sound in complete words.
usageTitle: Using 米 in words and sentences
usage: 米 can mean uncooked rice or the unit metre. 大米 and 米饭 are food words, while 一米 and 千米 express length.
writingTip: Separate the two upper short strokes, keep the centre upright, and balance the lower falling strokes around the crossing.

exampleSentences.meaning: I want to eat rice.

exampleSentences.pinyin: Zhè zhāng zhuōzi cháng yì mǐ.
exampleSentences.meaning: This table is one metre long.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 妈妈买了一袋大米和一些蔬菜。
exampleSentences.pinyin: Māma mǎi le yí dài dàmǐ hé yìxiē shūcài.
exampleSentences.meaning: Mum bought rice and some vegetables.

confusableCharacter.guidance: 米 adds two short upper strokes to a wood-like central form; 木 has no such pair.

hsk.note: Local HSK 2.0 Level 1 vocabulary includes 茶 (chá).

importance: 茶 helps learners read and write tea. Start with 喝茶 (drink tea) and compare the other everyday uses below.

components.explanation: The grass radical forms the top cover, a 人-shaped pair sits beneath it, and the lower strokes spread around a central upright.

readingNotes: Read 茶 as chá in this guide. Compare 喝茶 (hēchá) and 红茶 (hóngchá) to practise the sound in complete words.
usageTitle: Using 茶 in words and sentences
usage: 茶 names tea, varieties of tea and tea utensils. 红茶 is black tea in English, 绿茶 is green tea, and 茶杯 is a teacup.
writingTip: Keep the grass radical shallow, centre the middle cover, and allow enough room for the lower strokes instead of squeezing the three levels.

exampleSentences.meaning: I like drinking tea.

exampleSentences.pinyin: Qǐng gěi wǒ yì bēi lǜchá.
exampleSentences.meaning: Please give me a cup of green tea.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 吃完饭以后，我们坐下来喝茶。
exampleSentences.pinyin: Chī wán fàn yǐhòu, wǒmen zuò xià lái hē chá.
exampleSentences.meaning: After the meal, we sit down to drink tea.

confusableCharacter.guidance: 茶 and 荼 have similar outlines, but 荼 includes an additional horizontal in its lower part.

hsk.note: Local HSK 2.0 Level 3 vocabulary includes 花 (huā).

importance: 花 helps learners read and write flower; spend. Start with 花园 (garden) and compare the other everyday uses below.

components.explanation: The grass radical 艹 covers 化. Within 化, a narrow person component stands beside a separate turning shape.

readingNotes: Read 花 as huā in this guide. Compare 花园 (huāyuán) and 花钱 (huāqián) to practise the sound in complete words.
usageTitle: Using 花 in words and sentences
usage: 花 can name flowers or mean spend time or money. 一朵花 is a flower, 花钱 means spend money, and 花时间 means spend time.
writingTip: Make 艹 broad but shallow above 化, keeping the two lower components distinct and leaving a small vertical gap.

exampleSentences.meaning: This flower is beautiful.
We are walking in the garden.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 学习汉字需要花时间练习。
exampleSentences.pinyin: Xuéxí Hànzì xūyào huā shíjiān liànxí.
exampleSentences.meaning: Learning Chinese characters takes time and practice.

confusableCharacter.guidance: 花 adds 艹 above 化; removing the grass radical changes the word.

hsk.note: Local HSK 2.0 Level 3 vocabulary includes 草 (cǎo).

importance: 草 helps learners read and write grass. Start with 草地 (grassland; lawn) and compare the other everyday uses below.

components.explanation: The shallow grass radical 艹 sits above 早, whose 日 box is supported by 十. Each of the three levels needs visible space.

readingNotes: Read 草 as cǎo in this guide. Compare 草地 (cǎodì) and 草原 (cǎoyuán) to practise the sound in complete words.
usageTitle: Using 草 in words and sentences
usage: 草 names grass in 草地 and 草原. 草书 is cursive script and 草莓 is strawberry; the full word determines the sense.
writingTip: Keep 艹 shallow, centre the 日 box beneath it, and leave room for 十 at the bottom with a vertical extending below its crossbar.

exampleSentences.meaning: The lawn is green.
I like eating strawberries.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 请不要在刚种好的草地上走。
exampleSentences.pinyin: Qǐng bú yào zài gāng zhòng hǎo de cǎodì shàng zǒu.
exampleSentences.meaning: Please do not walk on the newly planted grass.

confusableCharacter.guidance: 草 adds 艹 above 早; without the grass radical the character means early.

seo.h1: How to Write 草 (cǎo): Stroke Order, Meaning & Examples
seo.description: Write 草 (cǎo), combining 艹 and 早. Practise grass and lawns, learn 草莓 for strawberry, and compare 草 with 早.

hsk.note: Local HSK 2.0 Level 1 vocabulary includes 猫 (māo).

importance: 猫 helps learners read and write cat. Start with 小猫 (kitten) and compare the other everyday uses below.

components.explanation: The narrow animal radical 犭 sits beside 苗. On the right, 艹 covers a small 田 with an internal cross.

readingNotes: Read 猫 as māo in this guide. Compare 小猫 (xiǎomāo) and 猫咪 (māomī) to practise the sound in complete words.
usageTitle: Using 猫 in words and sentences
usage: 猫 names a cat and forms animal compounds. 熊猫 means panda rather than domestic cat; 只 is normally used when counting cats.
writingTip: Keep the animal radical slim and leave enough width for 苗; the little 田 on the right needs a clear internal cross.

exampleSentences.pinyin: Wǒ jiā yǒu yì zhī māo.
exampleSentences.meaning: My family has a cat.
The kitten is under the chair.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 我们在动物园里看到了大熊猫。
exampleSentences.pinyin: Wǒmen zài dòngwùyuán lǐ kàn dào le dàxióngmāo.
exampleSentences.meaning: We saw giant pandas at the zoo.

confusableCharacter.guidance: 猫 has 犭 on the left, whereas 描 has 扌 beside the same 苗.

seo.h1: How to Write 猫 (māo): Stroke Order, Meaning & Examples
seo.description: Learn 猫 (māo), with 犭 beside 苗, and distinguish it from 描. Practise cat words, 熊猫 for panda, and counting cats with 只.

hsk.note: Local HSK 2.0 Level 1 vocabulary includes 狗 (gǒu).

importance: 狗 helps learners read and write dog. Start with 小狗 (puppy) and compare the other everyday uses below.

components.explanation: The narrow animal radical 犭 stands beside 句. The right-hand outer hook surrounds a small 口 without touching its inner box.

readingNotes: Read 狗 as gǒu in this guide. Compare 小狗 (xiǎogǒu) and 狗粮 (gǒuliáng) to practise the sound in complete words.
usageTitle: Using 狗 in words and sentences
usage: 狗 is the common character for dog. 小狗 is a puppy or small dog, while 热狗 is the borrowed food name hot dog.
writingTip: Keep 犭 narrow and the right-hand hook open enough to contain 口, leaving the small box clear of the surrounding stroke.

exampleSentences.meaning: That dog is big.
The puppy is waiting at the door.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 每天早上，他都带狗出去散步。
exampleSentences.pinyin: Měitiān zǎoshang, tā dōu dài gǒu chūqù sànbù.
exampleSentences.meaning: Every morning he takes the dog for a walk.

confusableCharacter.guidance: 狗 adds 犭 beside 句; omitting the animal radical produces a different character.

seo.title: 狗 (gǒu) Stroke Order, Meaning & Examples
seo.h1: How to Write 狗 (gǒu): Stroke Order, Meaning & Examples
seo.description: Write 狗 (gǒu), keeping 犭 separate from 句. Learn 小狗, 狗粮, 猎狗, and the food word 热狗 through everyday sentences.

hsk.note: Local HSK 3.0 Level 1 vocabulary includes 早 (zǎo).

importance: 早 helps learners read and write early; morning greeting. Start with 早上 (morning) and compare the other everyday uses below.

components.explanation: A compact 日 sits above 十. The lower vertical crosses its horizontal and extends downward; there is no grass radical above 日.

readingNotes: Read 早 as zǎo in this guide. Compare 早上 (zǎoshang) and 早餐 (zǎocān) to practise the sound in complete words.
usageTitle: Using 早 in words and sentences
usage: 早 means early and can serve as a short morning greeting. 早上 is morning, 早餐 is breakfast, and 来早了 means arrived early.
writingTip: Centre 日 over 十, leave a gap before the lower crossbar, and let the final vertical extend down beyond the horizontal.

exampleSentences.meaning: Good morning!
I eat breakfast every day.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 为了赶上火车，我们今天起得很早。
exampleSentences.pinyin: Wèile gǎn shàng huǒchē, wǒmen jīntiān qǐ de hěn zǎo.
exampleSentences.meaning: We got up early today to catch the train.

confusableCharacter.guidance: 早 has no grass radical above 日; adding 艹 changes it into 草.

seo.h1: How to Write 早 (zǎo): Stroke Order, Meaning & Examples
seo.description: Learn 早 (zǎo), with 日 above 十. Practise morning greetings, breakfast words, and arriving early, and compare 早 with 草.
